_comment: Copy to config.system.json for machine-wide defaults. ONLY the keys below are read by the code — verified against every load_system_config() call site. Render settings (resolution, fps, encoder, background style, blur) are CLI flags on `mediaconductor video` / `video-render`, not config keys; setting them here would silently do nothing.

bgm._comment: volume_db is how far the bed sits BELOW the measured narration loudness. Keep new values within -20..-32; -30 is the shipped default.

tts._comment: engine: auto | indextts | kokoro. speaker_wav is the voice-clone reference IndexTTS needs; with none, `--tts auto` falls back to Kokoro.

manga_video._comment: audio_source stays 'faded' in production: raw clip edges click. 'raw' is a diagnostic override.

cut_page._comment: Fallback panel reading order when the source language is unknown. `download` normally records it in manga.json and page-split resolves it automatically.

paths._comment: library_subdir renames data/library/. It is validated as a relative subpath, so it cannot escape data/.
